args.query: tariff rate customs duties imports by country

args.find: ["percent, net","up to 20","up to 15","up to 25","up to 35","35 percent","hearing","January 25","comment"]

sql: SELECT "year", SUM(customs_value_usd)/1e9 AS imports_bn, SUM(calculated_duties_usd)/1e9 AS duties_bn, SUM(calculated_duties_usd)/SUM(customs_value_usd) AS eff_rate FROM econ.usitc_tariffs WHERE "year" IN ('2024','2025') GROUP BY "year" ORDER BY "year"

SELECT "year", country_name, SUM(customs_value_usd)/1e9 AS imports_bn, SUM(calculated_duties_usd)/SUM(customs_value_usd) AS eff_rate FROM econ.usitc_tariffs WHERE "year"='2025' AND (country_name ILIKE 'China%' OR country_name ILIKE 'European Union%' OR country_name ILIKE 'Japan%' OR country_name ILIKE 'Korea%' OR country_name ILIKE 'Taiwan%' OR country_name ILIKE 'Vietnam%' OR country_name ILIKE 'India%' OR country_name ILIKE 'Brazil%' OR country_name ILIKE 'Mexico%' OR country_name ILIKE 'Canada%' OR country_name ILIKE 'Switzerland%' OR country_name ILIKE 'Singapore%' OR country_name ILIKE 'Thailand%' OR country_name ILIKE 'Malaysia%' OR country_name ILIKE 'Indonesia%' OR country_name ILIKE 'Bangladesh%' OR country_name ILIKE 'Cambodia%' OR country_name ILIKE 'Norway%') GROUP BY "year", country_name ORDER BY imports_bn DESC

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN country_name IN ('China','Taiwan','Japan','Korea, South','Korea','Vietnam','India','Switzerland','Thailand','Malaysia','Singapore','Indonesia','Bangladesh','Cambodia','Austria','Belgium','Bulgaria','Croatia','Cyprus','Czech Republic','Czechia','Denmark','Estonia','Finland','France','Germany','Greece','Hungary','Ireland','Italy','Latvia','Lithuania','Luxembourg','Malta','Netherlands','Poland','Portugal','Romania','Slovakia','Slovenia','Spain','Sweden') THEN customs_value_usd ELSE 0 END)/SUM(customs_value_usd) AS share14, SUM(customs_value_usd)/1e9 AS total_bn FROM econ.usitc_tariffs WHERE "year"='2025'
SELECT DISTINCT country_name FROM econ.usitc_tariffs WHERE "year"='2025' AND (country_name ILIKE 'Korea%' OR country_name ILIKE 'Czech%' OR country_name ILIKE '%Taiwan%')
SELECT country_name, SUM(customs_value_usd)/1e9 AS bn FROM econ.usitc_tariffs WHERE "year"='2025' AND (country_name ILIKE '%Korea%' OR country_name ILIKE 'Czech%') GROUP BY country_name
